subject: Notification of Change in Banking Information - Acme Fasteners LLC
text:
Please see the letter below. A signed copy is also attached for your records.

-----

ACME FASTENERS LLC
4410 Industrial Parkway
Dayton, OH 45414

November 6, 2026

To: Accounts Payable Department
Larkspur Industries

RE: Notification of Change in Banking Information

Dear Valued Customer,

Please be advised that, as part of a consolidation of our treasury operations, Acme Fasteners LLC will be transitioning its primary operating account to a new financial institution. Effective with all payments issued on or after December 1, 2026, please remit ACH and wire payments using the following instructions:

Bank Name: Bank of America, N.A.
ABA Routing Number: 026009593
Account Number: 4830 2219 7710
Account Name: Acme Fasteners LLC
Account Type: Business Checking

Payments sent to our previous account will be accepted through November 30, 2026. After that date the previous account will be closed and any payments sent to it may be returned or delayed.

Please update your vendor master file accordingly. Should you have any questions, please contact our office at the number below.

We appreciate your continued business.

Sincerely,

Margaret Ostrowski
Controller
Acme Fasteners LLC
(937) 555-0148
